description: This file defines a utility class Validator providing static methods to perform validation checks on data inputs within the Fineract project. It offers methods to validate data and throw exceptions if validation errors are found, supporting both general and domain-specific violations.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to validate data and throw exceptions upon validation errors.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates data according to the provided consumer and throws a PlatformApiDataValidationException if validation errors exist.

methods.name: validateOrThrowDomainViolation
methods.description: Validates data according to the provided consumer and throws a GeneralPlatformDomainRuleException if validation errors exist.
